name: United Kingdom
title: The UK Year-Wheel
tagline: Spin through what's growing, month by month.
attribution: BBC Good Food, Hubbub, BBC Gardeners’ World, Borough Kitchen, and specialist grower guides. Recipes are from BBC Good Food.

items.regions_notes: Harvest Aug-Nov; stored British apples available to May (controlled-atmosphere storage).

Traditional English season St George's Day (23 Apr) to Midsummer (21 Jun); Vale of Evesham (Worcs) holds PGI and is the historic heartland; also Kent, Suffolk, Cambs. Sources list Mar as occasional early start under protection.
UK glasshouse crop; NFU notes glasshouse technology extends availability into colder months.
Tender annual; UK outdoor Jun-Sep (BBC Good Food lists Jun-Aug); glasshouse extends.
Upland wild berry (moorlands), Jul-Sep.
Cultivated Jul-Sep; wild hedgerow (brambles) late Aug-Oct.
UK season Jun-Oct, peak Jul-Aug; ~10% of UK consumption home-grown (Fruit & Vine/British Berry Growers, 2026).
BAPL lists Bramley year-round (stores exceptionally); BBC Good Food marks best Oct-Mar. Armagh Bramley Apple holds PGI status (Co. Armagh, NI). Both kept: see audit.
specialist_sources: gov.uk Armagh Bramley Apple PGI spec

items.regions_notes: Harvest Aug-Apr (early varieties from 1 Aug; peak Oct-Dec, 40% of UK area harvested in Dec for Christmas). South Lincolnshire is a key growing area.
Year-round across types (savoy winter, pointed spring, red/autumn).
Maincrop Jun-Nov; stored British carrots available year-round (NFU).
Year-round across regions; Cornish winter cauliflowers notable (mild coast).
British season ~10 weeks (roughly mid-Jun-late Aug) centred on Kent; new varieties extending it (BBC News, Kent grower AC Hulme).
BBC Good Food lists May-Sep.
Fresh Oct-Dec; stored into Jan.
Fresh Kentish cobnuts mid-Aug-Oct; Kent is the historic centre (Victorian 'plats').
Lyth Valley (Westmorland/Cumbria) picking first 3 weeks of Sep, roadside sales second half Sep. BBC Good Food marks best Sep.
Hedgerow forage, late May-Jun.
Yorkshire Rhubarb Triangle (Wakefield-Leeds-Bradford) forcing sheds; season late Dec-Mar; PDO-protected name. Distinct from outdoor/maincrop rhubarb (Apr-Jun).
Official season late Mar-Jul, peak May-Jun (up to 1,000t/day shipped at peak). PGI-protected; only grown in Jersey.
At best Nov-Apr per British Leeks. Welsh Leeks hold PGI status (grown in Pembrokeshire; in stores Aug-Apr per Blas y Tir). Available much of the year.
Single-source (Hubbub, Oct). Heritage fruit, bletted after frost.
Outdoor UK mint roughly May-Oct; BBC Good Food lists May-Aug.
Year-round cultivated.

Earliest from Cornwall (mid-Apr, Gulf Stream frost-free fields), Pembrokeshire (harvest from early May) and Comber Earlies (Co. Down, NI - PGI, must be harvested May-Jul). Jersey Royals are the flagship early.
specialist_sources: gov.uk New Season Comber Potatoes/Comber Earlies PGI (harvest May-Jul)

items.regions_notes: British storage crop, effectively year-round (NFU); fresh harvest late summer.
Listed year-round by BBC Good Food (glasshouse/imports in winter).
Harvest Aug-Oct; stored pears to May (Conference to May per BAPL).
Vining pea harvest Jun-Aug (8-week 24/7 operation); Great British Pea Week early July. Fresh garden peas Jun-Sep.
UK glasshouse crop; NFU notes glasshouse availability in colder months.
Maincrop harvest Aug-Oct; stored year-round (NFU).
Oct-Nov.
Scottish season (Tayside/Angus heartland) late Jun-Oct - longer than England; peak Jul-Aug.
Outdoor/maincrop rhubarb roughly Apr-Jun/Jul; winter rows are forced rhubarb. BBC Good Food marks Jan-Jun overall.
Marsh samphire on Norfolk coast (Hunstanton-Sheringham) runs late Jun-Aug, best July; cut, don't uproot (illegal to pull roots). Some sources list from Apr (earlier coasts/imports) - see audit.
Protected cropping extends Mar-Dec; traditional field season Jun-Jul; retailers treat May-Sep as British season. Peak Jun-Jul.
Autumn-winter; 'neeps' in Scotland (Burns Night, 25 Jan).
Harvest Aug-Oct; each cob has a short ripeness window.
British glasshouse season spring-autumn per British Tomato Growers' Association; some year-round production with lights.

UK season May-Nov per The Watercress Company; production moves overseas in winter. Centre of production: Hampshire (Alresford, 'watercress capital') and Dorset. Some calendar sources list it Mar-Oct - see audit.
Woodland forage, Mar-May (best before flowering ends).
Autumn flush Aug-Nov; chanterelles peak Aug-Sep, ceps Sep-Oct (Scottish source).

months.name: January
months.blurb: January has 15 things at peak and 10 more in season. Much the same haul as December. Veg lead the peaks (11 of 15), with 4 fruits at their best.

months.name: February
months.blurb: February has 13 things at peak and 12 more in season. Much the same haul as January. Veg lead the peaks (10 of 13), with 3 fruits at their best.

months.name: March
months.blurb: March has 10 things at peak and 12 more in season. The leanest stretch of the year, so every pick counts. Veg lead the peaks (8 of 10), with 1 fruit at its best.

months.name: April
months.blurb: April has 8 things at peak and 14 more in season. The leanest stretch of the year, so every pick counts. Veg lead the peaks (5 of 8), with 1 fruit at its best.

months.name: May
months.blurb: May has 11 things at peak and 13 more in season. Much the same haul as April. Veg lead the peaks (5 of 11), with 2 fruits at their best.

months.name: June
months.blurb: June has 27 things at peak and 18 more in season. The wheel is filling up: 21 more in season than May. Veg lead the peaks (19 of 27), with 6 fruits at their best.

months.name: July
months.blurb: July has 35 things at peak and 19 more in season. The wheel is filling up: 9 more in season than June. Veg lead the peaks (20 of 35), with 11 fruits at their best.

months.name: August
months.blurb: August has 43 things at peak and 17 more in season. Much the same haul as July. Veg lead the peaks (24 of 43), with 15 fruits at their best.

months.name: September
months.blurb: September has 46 things at peak and 17 more in season. The fullest month on the wheel. Veg lead the peaks (30 of 46), with 12 fruits at their best.

months.name: October
months.blurb: October has 29 things at peak and 18 more in season. Winding down: 16 fewer in season than September. Veg lead the peaks (20 of 29), with 6 fruits at their best.

months.name: November
months.blurb: November has 22 things at peak and 8 more in season. Winding down: 17 fewer in season than October. Veg lead the peaks (16 of 22), with 3 fruits at their best.

months.name: December
months.blurb: December has 15 things at peak and 12 more in season. Much the same haul as November. Veg lead the peaks (11 of 15), with 3 fruits at their best.
